# Document Management MCP connectors

3 document management connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All document management connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/dms](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/dms).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [d.velop documents](connectors/d-velop.md) | d.velop documents (d.3one) DMS: search the repository, read document metadata and source properties, list repositories and categories. | 6 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/d-velop-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-d-velop-to-muse) |
| [DocuWare](connectors/docuware.md) | DocuWare document management: search file cabinets by field, read document metadata and index fields, list cabinets, dialogs and trays. | 7 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/docuware-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-docuware-to-muse) |
| [Paperless-ngx](connectors/paperless-ngx.md) | Paperless-ngx document management: full-text search over scanned documents, correspondents, document types, tags, storage paths and the OCR'd content of any document. | 9 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/paperless-ngx-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-paperless-ngx-to-muse) |
